content.comment_body: Is it possible to show analog bar scales with decimal point resolution in [product_name] Web Editor?
No, it's not possible in [product_name] Web Editor to display analog values with decimal points. In my opinion, this is a significant limitation.

The only workaround I can suggest is to change the unit, such as from bar to mbar. For instance, if you have a sensor for 0-10 bar and scale it to show values with two decimal places (0.00 - 10.00 bar as 0 to 1000 units), you can multiply the value by 10 to achieve 0 - 10,000 units, which can be displayed as 0 - 10,000 mbar in [product_name] Web Editor.
Thanks, I just want to display bar readings with decimal points, similar to how temperature in Celsius is shown with decimals.
Displaying a decimal point in [product_name] Web Editor is not possible.
